SmartM365.global.local.json.MailPowerBiEnabled: Adds the Power BI dashboard link block to report emails.
SmartM365.global.local.json.MailPowerBiUrl: Power BI dashboard URL used by the email link block.
SmartM365.global.local.json.MailPowerBiLogoPath: Logo shown next to the Power BI link, relative to the SmartM365 root.
SmartM365.global.local.json.MailPowerBiLinkText: Text of the Power BI link in report emails.
SmartM365.global.local.json.DefaultTenant: Tenant profile used when a script runs without -Tenant.
SmartM365.global.local.json.OnPremExecutionMode: How on-premises jobs run: LocalCache, Direct or Auto.
SmartM365.global.local.json.SmartM365RootPath: SmartM365 root folder; '.' means the folder that holds Config.
SmartM365.global.local.json.WorkspaceRootPath: Root of the data workspace; tokens such as {{SmartM365RootPath}} are resolved.
SmartM365.global.local.json.DataAllRootPath: Historical data root (DATA-ALL) per tenant profile.
SmartM365.global.local.json.OrchestratorSharedDataFolderPath: Shared orchestrator folder (configuration, election, heartbeats, pipeline runs).
SmartM365.global.local.json.LatestCsvFolderPath: Latest CSV folder (DATA-LAST) per tenant profile.
SmartM365.global.local.json.LogAllRootPath: Central log root (LOG-ALL) per tenant profile.
SmartM365.global.local.json.RetentionMaxCSV: Number of historical CSV copies kept per export.
SmartM365.global.local.json.RetentionMaxLogs: Number of log files kept per script.
SmartM365.global.local.json.MailBrandingEnabled: Applies the shared branded email template.
SmartM365.global.local.json.MailClientName: Client name shown in the email header.
SmartM365.global.local.json.MailClientLogoPath: Client logo file for the email header.
SmartM365.global.local.json.MailClientLogoMaxKB: Maximum client logo size embedded in emails, in KB.

Tenants/tenant.local.json.MailPowerBiEnabled: Tenant override of the Power BI link block; __USE_GLOBAL__ inherits the global value.
Tenants/tenant.local.json.MailPowerBiUrl: Tenant Power BI dashboard URL; blank inherits the global value.
Tenants/tenant.local.json.MailPowerBiLogoPath: Tenant override of the Power BI logo path.
Tenants/tenant.local.json.MailPowerBiLinkText: Tenant override of the Power BI link text.
Tenants/tenant.local.json.ProfileKey: Profile name; must match the file name and the -Tenant value.
Tenants/tenant.local.json.OrganizationKey: Organization part of TenantKey (lowercase letters, digits, hyphens).
Tenants/tenant.local.json.EnvironmentKey: Environment part of TenantKey (for example prod or test).
Tenants/tenant.local.json.TenantKey: OrganizationKey-EnvironmentKey; first column of every tenant CSV.
Tenants/tenant.local.json.AppId: Application (client) ID of the SmartM365 app registration.
Tenants/tenant.local.json.OrgDomain: Initial onmicrosoft.com domain used for Exchange Online app-only connections.
Tenants/tenant.local.json.RemoteRoutingDomain: Hybrid remote routing domain (mail.onmicrosoft.com) for Exchange checks.
Tenants/tenant.local.json.AdComputerNameCountryPrefixes: Map of computer name prefixes to countries for device reports.
Tenants/tenant.local.json.AdComputerNameCountryPrefixes.*: Country mapped to this computer name prefix.
Tenants/tenant.local.json.AdDomainCountryMappings: Map of Active Directory domains to countries.
Tenants/tenant.local.json.AdDomainCountryMappings.*: Country mapped to this Active Directory domain.
Tenants/tenant.local.json.DeviceSystemMaxObservationAgeHours: Maximum age of device system observations; null uses the script default.
Tenants/tenant.local.json.DeviceSystemOffsetlessGraphTimeZoneId: Time zone applied to Graph timestamps that carry no offset.
Tenants/tenant.local.json.ExpectedThirdPartyAV.DisplayName: Display name of the expected third-party antivirus.
Tenants/tenant.local.json.ExpectedThirdPartyAV.RegisteredNames: Antivirus product names accepted as the expected third-party antivirus.
Tenants/tenant.local.json.EndpointProtectionPolicy.Enabled: Enables the endpoint protection policy evaluation.
Tenants/tenant.local.json.EndpointProtectionPolicy.PolicyVersion: Version label of the endpoint protection policy.
Tenants/tenant.local.json.EndpointProtectionPolicy.MaxObservationA: Maximum observation age for the policy; null uses the script default.
Tenants/tenant.local.json.EndpointProtectionPolicy.Requirements: Endpoint protection requirements evaluated on devices.
Tenants/tenant.local.json.EndpointProtectionPolicy.ScopeRules: Rules that select the devices in scope of the policy.
Tenants/tenant.local.json.Thumb: Legacy name of the application certificate thumbprint.
Tenants/tenant.local.json.Thumbprint: Thumbprint of the application certificate used for app-only connections.
Tenants/tenant.local.json.SmtpServer: SMTP relay; empty sends through Microsoft Graph.
Tenants/tenant.local.json.From: Sender mailbox of report and error emails.
Tenants/tenant.local.json.MailSendAccessPolicyGroup: Mail-enabled group that scopes the Graph Mail.Send permission.
Tenants/tenant.local.json.EnableTeamsNotifications: Sends Teams notifications through the configured webhooks.
Tenants/tenant.local.json.TeamsAlertsWebhookUrl: Teams Workflows webhook for error alerts.
Tenants/tenant.local.json.TeamsInfosWebhookUrl: Teams Workflows webhook for success notifications.
Tenants/tenant.local.json.Cc: Default carbon-copy recipients of report emails.
Tenants/tenant.local.json.Subject: Prefix of email subjects.
Tenants/tenant.local.json.MailBrandingEnabled: Tenant override of the branded email template.
Tenants/tenant.local.json.MailClientName: Tenant override of the client name in the email header.
Tenants/tenant.local.json.MailClientLogoPath: Tenant client logo; blank inherits the global value.
Tenants/tenant.local.json.MailClientLogoMaxKB: Tenant override of the maximum client logo size, in KB.
Tenants/tenant.local.json.EnableSharePointUpload: Uploads generated CSV files to SharePoint.
Tenants/tenant.local.json.SharePointSiteHostname: SharePoint host name of the upload site.
Tenants/tenant.local.json.SharePointSitePath: Server-relative path of the upload site.
Tenants/tenant.local.json.SharePointLibraryDisplayName: Document library that receives the uploads.
Tenants/tenant.local.json.SharePointTargetFolderPath: Folder inside the library that receives the uploads.

Tenants/tenant.mail.local.json.Scripts.*.From: Sender mailbox for this script; __USE_GLOBAL__ uses the tenant From.
Tenants/tenant.mail.local.json.Scripts.*.Cc: Carbon-copy recipients for this script; __USE_GLOBAL__ uses the tenant Cc.
